Chapter 826: Chapter 25: Comprehension of the Void (Happy June 1st, Please Subscribe)_2

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan didn’t hesitate much, and immediately started to kill the void creatures in the space within the giant rock.

Facing these void creatures, Lin Yuan felt no compassion, as they weren’t even of the same species as he was, akin to ordinary people slaughtering chickens or pigs.

…

Boundless Void.

Nearly a hundred Perfect Demon True Lords gathered, all discussing the emergence of a second Tenth Stage being in the Boundless Void.

...

“The being that reached the Tenth Stage is called Martial Ancestor?”

“Martial Ancestor wants us to give up half of our territorial area to those weak ants?”

“Why is Martial Ancestor, being so powerful, so merciful to those ants?”

“If you have an opinion, why don’t you go talk to Martial Ancestor?”

“Forget it, I wouldn’t dare.”

Each of the Perfect Demon True Lords discussed, though some were quite dissatisfied with conceding half of their territory, it was merely discontent. Wanting them to argue with Martial Ancestor…even with ten times the courage, no Demon True Lord dared to do so.

They had all grown to the Ninth Stage Perfect level, not like those Sixth Stage or Seventh Stage demons who occasionally went insane.

The Ninth Stage Perfect demons were extremely rational, understanding that what shouldn’t be done, shouldn’t be done, and the will of the Tenth Stage Martial Ancestor couldn’t be defied.

Moreover, conceding only half of the territory didn’t touch these Perfect Demons’ bottom line, so the reaction wasn’t very intense either.

While numerous Perfect Demon True Lords debated the issues,

the Child of the Void sat high on the throne, somewhat nonchalantly observing the exchanges of the many Perfect Demons below.

“Hmm?”

“Martial Ancestor vanished from the Void Secret Realm?”

When Lin Yuan entered the hidden space in the core area of the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm, his aura disappeared from the Void Secret Realm, which was also detected by the Child of the Void.

“The entire Void Secret Realm holds no trace of Martial Ancestor’s aura?”

The Child of the Void carefully sensed it, speculating in his heart, *”Could it be that there is a secret in the Void Secret Realm that I don’t know about?”*

The Child of the Void had presided over the Void Secret Realm for many long years, considering himself exceptionally knowledgeable about it.

But now, the mysterious disappearance of Martial Ancestor’s aura naturally led the Child of the Void to ponder other possibilities.

Of course, the Child of the Void had no other ideas, after all, over the long years, he couldn’t discover the secret; even if given ten times or hundred times the time, he still wouldn’t be able to.

“That’s about enough.”

The Child of the Void glanced downward, at this moment the many Perfect Demon True Lords had mostly finished their debates.

Actually, ceding half of the territorial area didn’t affect the Child of the Void, it was mainly up to these Perfect Demon True Lords to decide how much they should yield.

“Martial Ancestor protected those ants because they could cultivate the Martial Tao?”

The Child of the Void quietly pondered in his heart, *”If there’s time, I must also try whether I can cultivate the Martial Tao.”*

Martial Ancestor valued the Martial Tao so much that the Child of the Void also became curious about it, planning to personally give it a try.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, ten years went by.

Hidden space in the Void Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged on top of the giant rock.

The invisible force of mental will swept in all directions, distorting time and space, forming a mental storm that raged continuously through the hidden space.

“My mental will…has finally reached the ultimate stage.”

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes, the vast mental will beginning to rapidly retract.

After ten years of absorption and constantly killing one void creature after another, Lin Yuan’s mental will finally reached its peak.

Reaching the peak meant that continuing to kill those Void Creature Monarchs had nearly stalled the improvement of his mental will.

“My current mental will index should be between thirty-three million, three hundred thousand to thirty-three million, four hundred thousand, right?”

Lin Yuan assessed himself, estimating.

“This range of the mental will index? Is thirty-three million, three hundred thirty-three thousand, three hundred thirty-three points?”

The specific amount of mental will index was something Lin Yuan couldn’t ascertain, even in the human civilization of the Main Universe where mental will could be measured, it was only a rough estimate.

Especially given that Lin Yuan’s current mental will index was extraordinarily high, making it even more impossible to accurately measure, relying only on his own experience and perception to judge.

And the range of thirty-three million three to forty thousand points of mental will reminded Lin Yuan of the number thirty-three million, three hundred thirty-three thousand, three hundred thirty-three.

In the Main Universe, Lin Yuan had encountered this number many times, such as the number of insights in the path of demonic evolution of the Magic Jade Tower? The count of silver-white text in “Void Interpretation?”

And the time initially needed for accumulating a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force at the Myriad Realms Gate?

And now, reaching the limits of the mental will index again also approached this number.

*”This number might hold a great secret,”* Lin Yuan secretly thought to himself, then placed this doubt at the bottom of his heart.

No matter what secret it held, it was still too distant for the current Lin Yuan, at least needing to reach the ultimate stage before having the ability to explore and scrutinize it.

*”A mental will index over thirty-three million is not considered weak even on the level of supreme beings, right?”* Lin Yuan quickly thought in his heart.

Eighteen million points of mental will index was the threshold for the most powerful.

Only when life makes an ultimate leap, residing permanently at the ‘shore,’ would one’s mental will quickly cross this line.

And thirty-three million three hundred plus thousand points of mental will index exceeded this threshold by a significant margin, possibly unreachable immediately by those newly at the Twelfth Stage of the ultimate.

Increasing mental will by one fold was countless times harder than increasing physical strength by the same amount.

“There are two hundred and three Void Creature Monarchs left.”

Lin Yuan glanced again at the Void Creature Monarchs within the giant rock space.
